descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-21 step 1 · “visit cadence, identity fields, Background/Admission Summary label, ... vitals/meds cadence”.

Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S23 Step 1 visit cadence and vitals/meds cadence per context

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1a Visit cadence changes per context. Hospital shows the hospital day, which advances each server calendar day and never freezes. … (UAT TC-21 step 1; UAT TC-01; UAT TC-11) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U1f Vitals/meds cadence changes per context. Hospital refreshes daily with 36 h windows; Nursing Home works per visit and the chronic list persists. What 'correct' means is not written down (Q7). (UAT TC-21 step 1; UAT 3.6; UAT 3.7) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given One patient per context, followed over several days / visits

When Compare how the hospital day / visit number advances, and how vitals and medications are refreshed and carried, in each context

Then Each one changes 'correctly' per context

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): There is no written definition of 'correct' (Q7). Partial oracles live elsewhere: the hospital day advances each server calendar day (TC-01 S05/S07; S26 here), the NH timeline is keyed 'Visit N – date' (TC-11), and the per-context vitals/meds windows are 3.6/3.7 (S17).

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); lane planned in the matrix: manual (not-testable)

S23 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-21.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20 re-run), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); secondary: DOC · Document check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.
